compiled:
📰 General

Trump Reasserts Iran War Justifications During Veterans Day Speech •

During Wednesday’s Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery, former President Donald Trump delivered a speech defending his administration’s decision to engage in military action against Iran. He asserted that the United States had “already won” the conflict, arguing that the objective of eliminating Iranian military presence in the region had been achieved. Trump also referenced a 250-foot arch erected in his honor at the cemetery, stating it represented “a tremendous tribute.” The event drew criticism from some veterans and observers who questioned the appropriateness of using a solemn national holiday to promote his political views.

🌍 World

Fringe Theory Gains Traction: Man Claims MH370 Was Teleported by Aliens •

Ashton Forbes, a former aerospace engineer, has become a leading proponent of the theory that Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 was not lost at sea but was instead transported through space by extraterrestrial beings. Forbes argues that radar anomalies and witness accounts, largely dismissed by official investigations, support his hypothesis. He posits that the aircraft was lifted into orbit and then teleported to a remote location. His ideas have garnered a significant following, fueled by the lack of definitive answers regarding the flight’s disappearance and the extensive, inconclusive search efforts.

🦅 US

Baby Rescued Alive From Crate in South Carolina – Father Involved •

An 11-month-old baby, Koah Sharpe, was rescued after being buried alive in a wooden crate in Lexington County, South Carolina. Authorities responded to a call reporting the child’s disappearance on Monday, discovering him within the crate. The baby’s father, Michael Comer, 25, is currently in custody and being investigated by law enforcement. Initial reports indicate the circumstances surrounding the incident are still under investigation, with details emerging regarding the crate’s location and the immediate response.

💰 Business

Costco Announces Special Dividend Amidst Growing Concerns About AI’s Impact •

Costco Wholesale announced a special dividend payment, prompting analysts to view the stock as a relatively stable investment during heightened anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence’s potential disruption. The company’s robust business model, characterized by strong membership sales and a focus on essential goods, is seen as a buffer against economic uncertainty fueled by AI advancements. Experts believe Costco’s consistent profitability and conservative financial strategy offer investors a safer haven compared to more volatile tech stocks. This move reinforces the retailer’s position as a dependable investment option in a rapidly changing market landscape.

💻 Technology

Conan: The Black Pyramid – New Roguelite RPG Announced for PC •

Developer Gematsu has announced Conan: The Black Pyramid, a new action roguelite role-playing game. The game blends sword and sorcery with cosmic horror elements, offering players a challenging experience. Conan: The Black Pyramid supports solo play and two-player online cooperative gameplay. Players will shape their character through a procedural generation system, ensuring varied gameplay experiences. The game is currently slated for PC release.

🎭 Entertainment

Karla Souza Joins ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ Spinoff Set in West Texas •

Karla Souza, previously known for her role in “How to Get Away with Murder” and “56 Days,” has been cast as a lead in a new “Grey’s Anatomy” spinoff. The series, currently untitled, is being produced by 20th Television under the leadership of Shonda Rhimes. The show will be set in West Texas and is expected to explore new medical cases and characters. Souza’s casting marks the first actor to join the project’s creative team.

🏅 Sports

49ers Re-Sign Former Player, Adding Depth to Defensive Backfield •

The San Francisco 49ers have recalled recently released cornerback Rashan Gary to their practice squad. This move provides the team with additional depth at a position of need following injuries to key players. Gary, who was released by the team earlier this season, will now compete for a roster spot. The 49ers’ coaching staff is evaluating his performance to determine his potential contribution to the team.

🔬 Science

Scientists Continue Decades-Long Search for Dark Energy’s Mysterious Nature •

Researchers are revisiting Albert Einstein’s 1916 General Theory of Relativity to investigate the perplexing nature of dark energy. The theory, initially presented in Annalen der Physik, remains a central point of contention in understanding the universe’s accelerating expansion. Scientists are analyzing discrepancies between Einstein’s predictions and current observations of dark energy. This ongoing investigation seeks to refine our understanding of this elusive component of the cosmos.

🩺 Health

New Needle-Free PCSK9 Drug Offers Hope for Injectable-Intolerant Patients •

A recent review published in Annals of Pharmacy and Therapeutics examines the potential of Lipfendra, an oral PCSK9 drug, as an alternative to injectable treatments for high cholesterol. Researchers at Binghamton University School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Science found the drug effective for individuals with intolerances to existing injectable medications. The review highlights Lipfendra’s ability to lower cholesterol levels through a novel oral delivery system. This development represents a significant advancement in managing high cholesterol for a previously underserved patient population.
